notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the 120-slot SMSG_ACTION_BUTTONS packed-u32 login snapshot (action bits 0-23, kind bits 24-31, zero=empty) and the 5-byte CMSG_SET_ACTION_BUTTON (u8 slot + u32 packed). MSUI implements both: PlayerActions.ApplyButtons parses the snapshot and WorldSession.BuildSetActionButtonBody writes u8+u32, wired to the one-send-per-local-mutation drag model in Program.ActionBars.cs.
